content.comment_body: Hello Forum, I am looking for advice or suggestions regarding my [product_name] unit – after a reset, I cannot log in using the default admin credentials. I followed the instructions and powered the unit off after the LEDs went off, but this did not resolve the issue. I am able to load the user interface at the IP address 192.168.0.3 as suggested. Holding the set button for 6 or 10 seconds produces no effect. Is there an alternative way to access the device via IP? Does it require a functioning SIM card to grant access? Currently, I see a constant F LED, which, according to documentation, likely means there is no SIM or no connection – which fits my situation.

Hello all, I managed to solve the issue. The manual recommends holding the reset for more than 10 seconds, so I tried holding it for 15 seconds, and the unit successfully reset. Everything is working now.

analysis.insight_summary: The user had trouble restoring access to a [product_name] device with standard reset procedures and default credentials, as described in the manual. Initial troubleshooting did not work, prompting the user to ask for alternative solutions. The problem was resolved by holding the reset button longer than suggested in the documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected the regular reset process to restore factory settings and allow admin login, based on instructions provided with the product.
pain_keywords: reset does not work as documented
